limits: Read from Terraform state only: no live inventory was read, so nothing is marked unmanaged. Attribute values and output values are never read: the only values kept from a resource are its id, ARN and tags (labels on Google Cloud), less the tags that look like secrets. 2 states read by terraform_remote_state are not in this snapshot, so anything that depends on them stops at an external placeholder: s3://acme-other/shared.tfstate, s3://acme-tfstate/env:/staging/net.tfstate. 1 terraform_remote_state data sources use a backend whose settings name no state this reader can place, so they point to a placeholder. 1 dependencies name an address the state does not hold and are left out. can_assume edges come only from the trust policies of the aws_iam_role resources a state holds: a role made outside Terraform has none, and identity policies, permission boundaries, service control policies and session policies are not read, so an edge says a trust policy allows it, not that the principal can. An account, a wildcard, a condition, a Deny statement or another account makes an edge inferred, and no condition or Deny is evaluated. can_read and can_write edges come only from iam-lens results read from a file: infra-ontology does not run iam-lens, read policies or call the cloud, so an edge says iam-lens judged the principal allowed on the IAM data it was given, which this snapshot does not hold and which may be older than the rest of it. Actions that read or list make can_read; actions that write, tag or change permissions make can_write; another level of action and any sts action make no edge. A result with a condition makes an inferred edge, and the condition is not kept; anonymous access makes an inferred edge too. Only the resources the snapshot holds have edges. 1 iam-lens results are for a resource this snapshot does not hold, and have no edge. 1 iam-lens results are for a resource that is not a concrete ARN (a wildcard, or too long), and have no edge. 1 iam-lens results say they found no collected data for an account, organization or principal the resource's policy names, so who can reach the resource is not all they list. 2 iam-lens entries are for an action of a level that makes no edge, or an sts action. 1 principals of iam-lens results (sessions, ARNs of other services, strings that are not a principal) are not turned into edges.
